name: Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Chalong Bay Resort
short_description: A newly opened, 280-room Courtyard resort near Chalong Pier, positioned between Phuket Old Town and the southern beaches as an island-hopping base.
ai_summary: Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Chalong Bay Resort is one of the newest Bonvoy properties on the island, opened near Chalong Pier -- a popular gateway for island-hopping day trips -- and roughly midway between Phuket Old Town and the Kata-Karon beach area. It offers 280 rooms with private balconies, two pools, a Kids' Club, and a small dining set built around an all-day bistro, a swim-up bar, and a bakery-café. Early guest feedback, drawn from a still-small base of roughly 140 TripAdvisor reviews given how recently the resort opened, is positive: reviewers describe an excellent location and atmosphere, well-maintained and comfortable rooms, attentive staff, and a relaxing setting away from the busiest tourist zones, with the seafood restaurant and beachside breakfast singled out for praise. Because it's such a new property, this sentiment should be treated as an early signal rather than an established pattern -- there simply isn't yet the volume of reviews that exists for the island's longer-running resorts. Minor guest notes include overly thick pillows and the fact that not all rooms have sea views, consistent with an inland-adjacent Chalong Bay location rather than a beachfront one.

elite_benefits: Room upgrades for Platinum Elite and above, subject to availability (select-service upgrade pool)
Bonus points in lieu of breakfast for Platinum Elite and above at hotels without full breakfast service
Enhanced Wi-Fi and a welcome amenity for all Elite tiers

pros: Convenient base near Chalong Pier for island-hopping day trips
280 rooms all with private balconies, plus two pools and a Kids' Club
Early guest reviews consistently praise the location, atmosphere, and room comfort
A relaxing setting away from Phuket's busiest tourist zones
cons: A very new property with a small review base (roughly 140 TripAdvisor reviews), so guest sentiment patterns are less established than at older resorts
Not directly beachfront -- some rooms lack sea views, and Chalong Bay itself is more of a marina/pier area than a swimming beach
At roughly 42 km, it's one of the farther properties in this directory from the airport
research_highlights: Early reviews describe the location and overall atmosphere as excellent and pleasant
Rooms are described as very well maintained, clean, and comfortable
The on-site restaurant is praised for seafood, with breakfast served near the beach specifically mentioned
research_watchouts: As a newly opened resort, the review volume is still small, so early positive sentiment should be treated as a preliminary signal rather than an established track record
Some guests note pillows are too thick and that sea views aren't available from all rooms

faqs.question: Is Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Chalong Bay Resort on the beach?
faqs.answer: Not directly -- it's located near Chalong Pier and Chalong Bay, a popular gateway for island-hopping trips, rather than on a swimming beach itself, and not all rooms have sea views.

faqs.question: Is Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Chalong Bay Resort a new hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's one of the newest Marriott Bonvoy properties on the island, which means its guest review base is still small (roughly 140 reviews) compared with Phuket's longer-established resorts, even though early feedback is positive.
